text:
I think I have experienced “AGI”…

Just did a 30-minute “phone call” with @bot. Together we got back to about 20 emails, organised my calendar for the week, wrote a proposal for my team, ordered lunch for my family, booked (and paid for) a hotel, and arranged a cab to the airport. It also gave me some great advice along the way. 

Did it all 100% “hands free” with my baby fast asleep on my chest. 

If this is what life is like with superintelligence, I am all in.
